thread:
Priya S: hey team 👋 accepted the org invite but i still can't push to my feature branch, getting a 403 when trying `git push origin feature/onboard-logging`
Alex K: did you finish the SSO/2FA step? sometimes GH blocks org actions until both are set up
Priya S: i set up 2FA with the authenticator app earlier, and SSO shows me as 'connected' in the settings page. not sure why it's blocking pushes.
Sam R: can you paste the exact error? also are you in the `pkg-maintainers` or `frontend-team` org team? CODEOWNERS requires membership for some repos.
Priya S: error: remote: You are not permitted to push to this repository. fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/example-repo.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
Maya L: ah that looks like repo-level write perms denied. @Priya S, which repo are you trying? sometimes new repos are gated by team assignment via the `onboard-sync` job.
Priya S: `infra/telemetry-agent` — i tried to open a PR but the branch protection prevents me from pushing to the remote branch directly (we usually push to my fork first at my understanding)
Alex K: we prefer forks for new hires, but you should still be able to push to a personal branch if we add you to the repo's write team. i'll check the teams mapping.
DevEx Bot: [onboard-sync] new member Priya S added to org on 2140556789. Pending team assignments: pkg-maintainers (required), infra-readers (optional).
Sam R: hmm onboard-sync shows pending — looks like your GitHub account email might be an alias that's not mapped to your employee record. @Maya L can you confirm mapping?
Maya L: confirmed — Priya's org user exists but the people-ops email is `pri.s@redwood.com` while her GH primary is `priya.s@gmail.com`. i'll kick off a reconciliation and add the `pkg-maintainers` team temporarily.
Priya S: thanks! also the PR shows CODEOWNERS requested review from `@pkg-maintainers`. will adding me to that team auto-approve or just allow me to push?
Alex K: adding you to the team won't auto-approve — it will allow you to push and request reviews from that team. CODEOWNERS still triggers reviewers but you won't be blocked by branch protection on membership.
Maya L: done — added you to `pkg-maintainers` and retriggered the onboard-sync flow. you should now be able to push; try `git push origin priya/onboard-logging`
Priya S: trying now... success! :tada: can submit the PR. one last quick q — is there a doc for the 2FA + SSO troubleshooting steps? mine looked connected but i wasn't mapped initially.
DevEx Bot: onboarding docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/github-ss0-2fa (internal) and contact #devex for edge cases.
Sam R: for future hires we added a checklist: confirm GH primary email matches HR record, confirm SSO org connect, and run `onboard-check --gh` (internal CLI) before opening repo PRs.
Priya S: perfect, thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help!
Alex K: welcome aboard again :wave: ping us if anything else pops up.
